note: Primary sources; read scopes distinguish manuscript sections, abstracts and catalogs. Project proposals are inferences.

sources.title: Learning from Inflation Experiences
sources.version: Author draft dated 2013-04-04; journal publication independently checked on author bibliography
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction and age-dependent learning framework in author draft, including equations (1)–(5); not full replication
sources.project_limit: National age-cohort history is a proxy, not verified personal biography or a universal age ranking.

sources.title: Exposure to Grocery Prices and Inflation Expectations
sources.authors: Francesco D’Acunto; Ulrike Malmendier; Juan Ospina; Michael Weber
sources.version: Author draft dated 2020-08-03, not journal typeset final
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction and sections on purchase frequency, sign of changes and robustness in author draft
sources.project_limit: Expenditure shares are not purchase frequencies; underlying linked scanner data are not available in this project.

sources.title: From traits to rates: How personality shapes inflation expectations
sources.version: Dated 2026-01-20 working paper, Austrian HFCS 2023 wave
sources.read_scope: Abstract/nontechnical summary, data and fieldwork description, key reported associations; not full econometric replication
sources.project_limit: Observational Austrian working paper. Added explained variance is relative to demographics, not 70% of all variance; coefficients not transferable to US personas.

sources.title: Rounding Probabilistic Expectations in Surveys
sources.version: Published abstract and author bibliography checked; PMC full-text direct access showed verification page
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic metadata, not complete full-text review
sources.project_limit: HRS findings do not identify SCE rounding type proportions or justify universal thresholds.

sources.title: Tail and Center Rounding of Probabilistic Expectations in the Health and Retirement Study
sources.authors: Pamela Giustinelli; Charles F. Manski; Francesca Molinari
sources.version: Author final manuscript; issue date confirmed by author bibliography. Not equating 2018 working paper with 2022 issue.
sources.read_scope: Abstract/introduction and section 2 inference framework, especially stability and rounding bounds; not full replication
sources.project_limit: Separate scalar probability questions are not SCE ten-bin distributions. Observed multiples give constraints, not uniquely identified rounding rules.

sources.title: Assessing small non-zero perceptions of chance: The case of H1N1 (swine) flu risks
sources.authors: Wändi Bruine de Bruin; Andrew M. Parker; Jürgen Maurer
sources.version: Primary manuscript indexed abstract checked; direct page access blocked by verification
sources.read_scope: Publicly indexed primary abstract, not archived full text
sources.project_limit: Health-risk evidence about small probabilities, not a causal explanation of SCE deflation zeros or a zero-probability target.

sources.title: Advances in Prospect Theory: Cumulative Representation of Uncertainty
sources.read_scope: Abstract/introduction and section 1.1 distinction between decision weights and probabilities
sources.project_limit: Decision weighting for choices is not a justified transformation of elicited Q9 belief probabilities.

sources.title: Quantifying the Persona Effect in LLM Simulations
sources.read_scope: Abstract, motivation and reported overall conclusions; not re-running their evaluated NLP tasks
sources.project_limit: Subjective NLP tasks are not SCE; prompt responsiveness must be measured locally.

sources.title: Questioning the Survey Responses of Large Language Models
sources.authors: Ricardo Dominguez-Olmedo; Moritz Hardt; Celestine Mendler-Dünner
sources.read_scope: Official conference abstract and reported formatting/order effects; not full replication
sources.project_limit: ACS-style categorical survey tasks differ from open Q9 probabilities; equivalent wording is a control, not persona evidence.

sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
sources.version: Current author preprint fetched 2026-10-12; hash retained, PDF version not inferred from unversioned download URL
sources.read_scope: Section 3.2.3 on rejection sampling fine-tuning, PDF pages 13–14; not complete 77-page review
sources.project_limit: Fine-tuning involves ranking candidate outputs and updating weights. Prompt variations alone are not fine-tuning.

sources.title: Understanding America Study — UAS 1 and Comprehensive File
sources.authors: USC Center for Economic and Social Research
sources.version: Current catalog, not a historical microdata vintage
sources.read_scope: Official indexed UAS1 catalog and comprehensive-file public description; direct UAS1 fetch error retained as limitation
sources.project_limit: Login/registration/data-use agreement needed; no joint sample count, inflation linkage or historical data availability has been audited.
